Freeform builds AI-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial-scale parts at the speed of human ideation. By treating manufacturing as a single integrated system, we unlock a new era of innovation where complex hardware is designed, built, and scaled without limits.

As an Associate CNC Machinist, you’ll play a key role in Freeform’s machining and post-processing operations. You’ll work with advanced multi-axis CNC machines that transform 3D-printed metal parts into precision-finished aerospace-grade components, helping bridge the gap between 3D printing and final production. The right candidate for this role will be an energetic go-getter with a positive attitude and a “no job too big or small” mentality. 3D printing experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, collaborative individuals who love solving hard problems and creating amazing technology!

• Operate and support CNC machining, including setup, basic programming edits, tool changes, and part inspection

• Use manual machining tools such as mills, lathes, bandsaws, and grinders to support part finishing and fixture creation

• Learn and apply precision measurement techniques to verify part quality and tolerances

• Support maintenance and troubleshooting of CNC machines and shop equipment (air compressors, chillers, inert gas systems, etc.)

• Contribute to shop organization and process improvements, helping build a high-function

Seurat Technologies is transforming metal manufacturing through Area Printing®, a proprietary additive manufacturing process pioneered at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory.
